---
title: "About the Shu Lab"
subtitle: "Clinical questions, collaborative science, and practical evidence."
---

::: {.page-intro}
The Shu Lab is based in Pittsburgh and collaborates across UPMC, Brown University, and partner institutions. We bring together clinical neuroscience, epidemiology, biostatistics, and engineering to study stroke prevention, treatment outcomes, clinical data, and recovery.
:::

Our approach is simple: begin with a meaningful clinical question, choose the method that best fits it, and make the result useful to patients, clinicians, or other researchers.
